newsitem.title: UK: Aug Forties schedule set higher at 25.7 mln bbls.
newsitem.headline: Aug Forties schedule set higher at 25.7 mln bbls.

text.p: August loadings from Britain's North Sea Forties field are scheduled at 25.7 million barrels, up from an expected 22.4 million barrels in July, traders said.
The August programme is made up of 14 cargoes of 500,000 barrels, 27 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, one vessel of 650,000 barrels and one vessel of 850,000 barrels.
A further one million barrels is going directly to Forties pipeline operator BP's refinery at Grangemouth, traders said.
Early July loadings were thinned out by longer than expected maintenance, which had already cut deep into the June programme, which ran to a slim 16.8 million barrels.
Daily liftings of Forties in August will run at an average of 829,000 barrels per day, up from 722,000 bpd in July.
Forties loads at BP's Hound Point terminal in eastern Scotland.
